attr.title: Punktfunk
attr.desc: Experimental native Punktfunk low-latency streaming client for TrimUI Smart Pro S.
attr.desc_md: Experimental **Punktfunk** native low-latency streaming client for **TrimUI Smart Pro S**. Ships the headless CLI plus the SDL3/Vulkan session renderer, with pairing and PortMaster launchers.
attr.inst: Run Punktfunk Setup once, pair with your Punktfunk host, then launch Punktfunk.
attr.inst_md:
1. Run **Punktfunk Setup**.
2. Select/enter the host and enter its pairing PIN.
3. Launch **Punktfunk**.

The first release is experimental because the final SDL3/Vulkan WSI path depends on the TSPS Mali firmware stack.
